verdict.rationale: Appwrite exposes a full public REST/SDK API covering auth, databases, storage, functions, messaging, plus llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable docs, a CLI for non-interactive/headless automation, and an official MCP server letting agents call the API and CLI with SDK-accurate calls. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent hands-on corroboration from third parties of the documented API workflows.
